prompt:
The attached image is an ENEMY CONCEPT SHEET. Look at the THIRD figure from the left — the hunched shambling humanoid corpse wearing a cracked white oni mask with green data leaking out of it. THAT is the character you must draw. Ignore the other three figures.

Produce a PIXEL ART sprite sheet of that hunched corpse creature performing an animation cycle.

CRITICAL — WHAT THIS CREATURE IS NOT: it is NOT a samurai. It is NOT a swordsman. It has NO sword, NO katana, NO scabbard, NO white cape, NO white haori, NO long blue ponytail, NO red mask, NO horns. Do not draw a heroic character. Draw a shambling undead husk.

THE CREATURE — 'BOTNET NODE': a gaunt hunched humanoid corpse, side view facing RIGHT, shuffling forward. Its body is emaciated and skeletal-thin. It wears filthy tattered rags in near-black #0A0E1F and deep indigo #1E33D9 that hang in shreds off its frame. Its exposed skin is dead near-black with thin pale cyan #8FE8FF rim highlights, so it reads as a dead process rather than living flesh. Its head is BALD — no hair at all. Its face is covered by a CRACKED WHITE oni mask, and bright acid-green #C6F02A data glyphs and light pour out through the crack in the mask and from its open mouth. Its arms are long, thin and dangling low, ending in clawed fingers. It walks with a broken, hunched posture, head down.

POSES — 6 total in a single horizontal row: frames 1-3 are a slow shuffling walk cycle, dragging one foot, rags swaying; frame 4 raises its head and shrieks with green data erupting from its mouth; frame 5 lunges forward with both claws out; frame 6 collapses to its knees dying as green data drains away and the mask splits apart.

PIXEL ART STYLE: chunky visible square pixels on a consistent grid, hard aliased edges, a 1-pixel dark outline on every shape, flat cel shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. 16-bit Castlevania style.

LAYOUT: PURE BLACK background (#000000). ONE SINGLE HORIZONTAL ROW of 6 poses with wide empty black gutters between them. NO second row. NO grid lines, NO borders, NO ground lines, NO text, NO labels. Every pose complete and uncropped with generous black space above and below.

STRICT PALETTE — ONLY: #000000 #0A0E1F #1E33D9 #2B6FE8 #35C6F4 #8FE8FF #8F1116 #E01F26 #C6F02A #6B8A0F #FFFFFF #4A5568.
